note: Authoritative inventory of every environment variable the code reads, plus the few read by provider SDKs or operator tooling (`read_by`). Values live in Doppler (logloads project: dev, stg, prd) and reach Vercel through the Doppler sync; never commit real values. tools/integration-readiness.mjs derives its checks from `targets`, `integrations` and each variable's `integration`, `doppler_configs`, `must_be_unset_in`, `allowed_values` and `expected_by_target`; tools/integration-readiness-contract.test.mjs keeps this file, .env.example and the code readers in agreement.

fresh_start.note: Every earlier LogLoads provider project (Supabase, Clerk, Stripe, Resend, PostHog, Sentry, Vercel) was deleted to start fresh, so every key is new. Earlier provider snapshots below are historical evidence only. Follow docs/INTEGRATIONS.md and verify with pnpm integrations:check.

provider_verification.scope: Vercel Production variable names/targets, Supabase project and migration state, private media bucket, Anthropic credential-review readiness, Resend domain status, and code-derived activation gates
provider_verification.warning: Secret values remain intentionally unreadable. A variable listed as present is provider-verified by name and target, not copied into this document. Historical: the verified projects were deleted before the 2026-11-03 fresh start.

private_media_storage.rule: Supabase Storage is the only active private-media provider. The project reference must match the configured Supabase URL, the bucket must remain private with the exact media limits below, and any nonblank variable under a forbidden legacy prefix disables media.
private_media_storage.legacy_boundary: Historical cloudinary provider literals remain parseable as stored metadata only. No Cloudinary signing, upload, read-back, delivery, dependency, or environment activation path exists.

commercial_authority.terms: The host owes LogLoads 5% of host-stated driver pay on top after the physical movement completes. Fees are invoiced monthly in arrears. There is no monthly minimum, posting fee, driver charge, or custody of transportation funds.
commercial_authority.legacy_boundary: legacy_percentage remains read-only for frozen accepted terms and obligations; no new activity may enter it.
commercial_authority.subscription_boundary: subscription_v1 and its plan catalog remain read-only evidence for obligations accepted while that decision governed; no new enrollment, tier allowance, overage, renewal, or usage obligation may be created.

local.note: Developer machine. pnpm setup:local writes apps/web/.env.local; check it with --env-file apps/web/.env.local, or doppler run --config dev.

preview.note: Any Vercel Preview deployment. NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL may be unset (VERCEL_URL is used).

staging.note: The long-lived staging deployment: Preview environment with the stg config and its own Supabase project.

production.note: https://logloads.com. Live keys only after explicit founder authorization.

integrations.label: App origin and V2 preview flag
Supabase database tooling (migrations; not read by the app)
Set by Vercel, Next.js or CI (never set by hand)
